RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from the information provided.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Your PhD and eight years of section leadership are substantial qualifications, but they do not establish that you best met every selection criterion. Her leadership experience could be particularly relevant to heading the laboratory.

Follow up on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, and how your qualifications and interview performance were assessed. Check applicable response and appeal deadlines; these depend on jurisdiction and employer.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based remarks or inconsistent treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition.
